figures.caption: FIG. 1. (a) Schematic of the partially collinear 2DES setup. Two phase-locked broadband pump pulses, separated by a delay tpu, excite the sample; after a waiting time τ a probe pulse measures the response. The reflected probe is spectrally dispersed by a spectrometer to define the detection axis ℏωpr. Pump replicas are produced by a common-path wedge interferometer to ensure phase stability and precise control of time delay tpu (see Supplementary Sec. S1). (b) Sketch of a 2D spectrum S(ℏωpr, ℏωpu; τ) at fixed τ . The dashed diagonal marks ℏωpu = ℏωpr; an off-diagonal cross-peak (ℏωc, ℏωa) is indicated. (c) Illustration of a boson-mediated three-level scheme. First, pump photons drive a vertical transition to a virtual level at ℏωa = ℏωb + ℏΩq, which relaxes to the real state ℏωb by emitting a boson (energy ℏΩq, momentum q). This results in the creation of a transient non-thermal boson population peaked at ℏΩq. Second, the probe promotes the system to a virtual intermediate state at ℏωc = ℏωb − ℏΩq, and the transition is completed to the real state by absorbing a non-thermal boson of energy ℏΩq. The corresponding crosspeak is observed at (ℏωc, ℏωa) in S(ℏωpr, ℏωpu; τ) in panel (b).

FIG. 6. (a) Time-resolved trace of the off-diagonal 2DES signal S(ℏωpr = 1.3 eV, ℏωpu = 1.7 eV; τ) measured on optimally doped Y-Bi2212 at T = 300 K. The dashed line indicates the pump-probe pulse envelope. (b) Correlation energy ∆E = ℏωpu − ℏωpr (left axis, circles) and corresponding lower bound of the electron-boson coupling strength λ (right axis, squares) extracted from the off-diagonal 2DES signal as a function of hole doping at T = 300 K. The top axis shows the corresponding critical temperatures Tc(K). Error bars of 22 meV are estimated from peak position distribution in different measurements.

FIG. 2. (a) 2DES map of optimally doped Y-Bi2212 measured at 300 K with a pump fluence of 400 µJ/cm2, recorded at a fixed delay time τ = 40 fs. The color map shows the differential reflectivity ∆R/R as a function of pump photon energy ℏωpu (vertical axis) and probe photon energy ℏωpr (horizontal axis). The white dashed line marks the diagonal direction ℏωpu = ℏωpr. Black dashed lines indicate the position of the off-diagonal peak (see Supplementary Sec. S3). The inset shows the position of the measurement in the temperature-doping phase diagram. (b) 2DES map measured under the same experimental conditions as in panel (a) but at a longer delay time, τ = 340 fs. The same color scale as in panel (a) is used; for clarity, the signal amplitude is multiplied by a factor of two. The off-diagonal resonance observed at τ = 40 fs is preserved at long delay.
